source_language_scope: Supplied English records only; no new Greek, Hebrew or critical-apparatus verification.
numbering: Exact original nested chapter/verse order, references and anchors retained. The actual inventory contains 822 units in 22 chapters; continuation units and numeric gaps are recorded in inventory.json.
method: Read complete actual source and retained target passages with necessary context; reread every particular explanation before completing its initial curated pass. The full source inventory preceded review and earned zero review credit.
completion_definition: Completed means the initial curated cross-reference pass: the source verse and every listed target passage were read in the pinned Saints-Translation English records, and each retained pair has a specific explanation. It does not mean every possible biblical connection has been exhausted, or independent scholarly approval.
canon_policy: Old Testament cross-references exclusively within the Saints Holy Bible 70-book edition: 43 source books in their exact order and divisions; matching targets restricted to its 70 books.

target_verses.text: Solomon built his own house in thirteen years.

target_verses.text: Now I have sent you a wise man, possessing understanding: Chiram, my father,

his mother is from Dan’s daughters, and his father is a Tyrian man. source_verse.text: This was the matter concerning how he raised his hands against King Solomon: he built the citadel and closed the enclosure of the City of David his father.

target_verses.text: There was a man from Ephraim’s hill country, Solomon’s servant, whose name was Jeroboam. His mother’s name was Sarira, a prostitute. He built the citadel through the burdens of Ephraim’s house; he enclosed the City of David and was rising up against the kingdom.

source_verse.text: King Solomon slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the City of David. Rehoboam his son reigned in his place in Jerusalem. He was sixteen years old when he became king, and reigned twelve years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Naanan, daughter of Anan son of Nahash, king of the sons of Ammon. He did evil before the Lord and did not walk in the way of David his father.

target_verses.text: Rehoboam son of Solomon reigned over Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city the Lord chose from all Israel’s tribes to place His name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonite.

source_verse.text: Jeroboam went to Shechem in Ephraim’s hill country and gathered Israel’s tribes there. Rehoboam son of Solomon went up there. The Lord’s word came to Shemaiah the Elamite, saying, “Take a new garment which has not entered water, tear it into twelve pieces, give it to Jeroboam, and say to him, ‘Thus says the Lord: Take ten pieces for yourself, to clothe yourself.’” Jeroboam took them. Shemaiah said, “Thus says the Lord concerning Israel’s ten tribes.”

target_verses.text: At that time Jeroboam went out from Jerusalem, and the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him on the road and took him aside from the road. Ahijah was clothed in a new garment, and both were in the plain.
Ahijah took hold of his new garment which he was wearing and tore it into twelve pieces.
He said to Jeroboam, “Take ten pieces for yourself, because thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: ‘Behold, I am tearing the kingdom from Solomon’s hand and will give you ten scepters.
